sentences: I came here with my sister for a special festival, Songkran.
People in Thailand celebrate it in April.
It is very hot in April, so this festival is perfect for this time of year.
On the first day, people clean their homes.
It means a new and fresh start.
Then, they go outside with water guns and buckets.
They throw water at everyone around them.
It's like a big water fight on the streets!
I got very wet, but I loved it.
Thai people also pour water on the hands of older family members to show respect.
I think Songkran is a great festival.
People forget their worries and just have fun!
I want to come back again next year with my whole family.

items.statement_en: The writing opens with a greeting.
The person writing this says his name is Lucas.
Lucas is staying in India right now.

items.statement_ko: Lucas는 형과 함께 축제를 보러 왔다.
items.why_ko: 형이 아니라 여동생(누나), 즉 sister와 함께 왔다.
_evidence_text: I came here with my sister for a special festival, Songkran.
items.statement_en: Lucas came to the festival together with his brother.

_evidence_text: People in Thailand celebrate it in April.
items.statement_en: People in Thailand hold Songkran in December.

items.statement_ko: 4월은 매우 더워서 이 축제가 이 시기에 아주 잘 어울린다.
items.why_ko: 4월이 덥기 때문에 축제가 이 시기에 완벽하다고 했다.
_evidence_text: It is very hot in April, so this festival is perfect for this time of year.
items.statement_en: April is very hot, so this festival fits that time of year well.

_evidence_text: On the first day, people clean their homes.
items.statement_en: On day one of the festival, people clean their houses.

items.statement_ko: 집을 청소하는 것은 새롭고 산뜻한 시작을 뜻한다.
_evidence_text: It means a new and fresh start.
items.statement_en: Cleaning the house stands for a new and fresh beginning.

items.statement_ko: 사람들은 물총과 양동이를 들고 밖으로 나간다.
items.why_ko: water guns와 buckets를 들고 나간다고 했다.
_evidence_text: Then, they go outside with water guns and buckets.
items.statement_en: People go out carrying water guns and buckets.

items.statement_ko: 사람들은 오직 자기 가족에게만 물을 뿌린다.
items.why_ko: 주변의 모든 사람에게(everyone around them) 물을 뿌린다.
_evidence_text: They throw water at everyone around them.
items.statement_en: People throw water only at their own family members.

items.statement_ko: 그 모습은 거리에서 벌어지는 큰 물싸움 같다.
_evidence_text: It's like a big water fight on the streets!
items.statement_en: It looks like a huge water fight happening on the streets.

items.statement_ko: Lucas는 몸이 젖어서 축제가 싫었다고 말한다.
items.why_ko: 많이 젖었지만 아주 좋았다(loved it)고 했다.
_evidence_text: I got very wet, but I loved it.
items.statement_en: Lucas says he hated the festival because he got wet.

items.statement_ko: 태국 사람들은 존경을 표하려고 어른의 발에 물을 붓는다.
_evidence_text: Thai people also pour water on the hands of older family members to show respect.
items.statement_en: To show respect, Thai people pour water on the feet of older family members.

items.why_ko: Everyone looks happy and kind라고 했다.
items.statement_en: He says that everyone there seems happy and kind.

_evidence_text: I think Songkran is a great festival.
items.statement_en: Lucas believes Songkran is a wonderful festival.

items.statement_ko: 사람들은 축제 동안 걱정거리를 더 많이 떠올리게 된다.
items.why_ko: 걱정을 잊고 즐긴다(forget their worries)고 했다.
_evidence_text: People forget their worries and just have fun!
items.statement_en: During the festival, people end up thinking about their worries even more.

items.statement_ko: Lucas는 내년에 혼자 다시 오고 싶어 한다.
items.why_ko: 혼자가 아니라 온 가족(whole family)과 함께 다시 오고 싶어 한다.
_evidence_text: I want to come back again next year with my whole family.
items.statement_en: Lucas hopes to come back alone next year.
